question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**many**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the **'Kind Brahmadutta'.**
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**many**'.
 
• It means 'a large number of people or things लोगों या वस्‍तुओं की बड़ी संख्‍या, बहुत सारे, अनेक'.
 
 
• *Example: Have you made **many** friends at school yet?*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *A long time ago, Brahmadutta was the king of Benaras, Like **many** kings he was interested only in (2)_______ and his favourite animal to hunt (3)_______ deer. The king would ride over (4)________ planted fields and destroy the crops. He would(5)______ men from the village to help him in the hunt even at the harvest time!.*

The correct answer is 'hunting&l
